confidence_notes: Restaurant and coffee anchors are based on crowdsourced cost-of-living aggregates (Numbeo, Expatica) that show 2025-2026 figures in EUR, converted to USD at an approximate EUR/USD of 1.16. Beer and coffee draw on several sources that broadly agree. Cocktail and wine are weaker: the cocktail is a single-menu example plus city-bar judgment, and the wine glass is inferred from the beer relationship, since no reliable restaurant wine-by-the-glass figure was found. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates for July peak season, not based on any live listings or accommodation searches. FX is stale: the only RBA observation I could verify was 0.7088 on 2026-03-20, and I could not retrieve the RBA's current daily table, so the rate may be materially out of date on the generation date.
comparable_city_reasoning: Compared with other mid-sized Alpine and Austrian tourist cities (for example Salzburg and Bolzano-type markets), with restaurant prices close to the Numbeo Innsbruck aggregates. Accommodation is a model estimate informed by Innsbruck's summer tourism demand and the typical hostel and hotel price tiers in Austria.
